# SanoVault

> SanoVault is a free (beta) personal health record app for families. Each family has a folder where members can upload or scan lab reports, prescriptions, discharge summaries and other medical papers, keep a medicine list for each person, and create time-limited share links. It is free during the beta; AI extraction and summaries may become paid later.

## Who it is for, and what it is not

SanoVault is for families who want to keep their own medical papers, including older paper reports and files from different hospitals and labs, in one place.

- It is not a hospital system and does not give medical advice.
- It does not currently fetch records from hospital or lab systems; you add the files you have.
- It is available as a web app and an iOS app (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sanovault/id6812724169). There is no Android app yet.
- Read the privacy policy for information about data handling and service providers.
